SELECT r.role_code FROM sys_role r JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.role_id = r.id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId}
SELECT r.role_name FROM sys_role r JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.role_id = r.id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId}
